text: For #687, every process in the plumbing sandbox, and every CI job, gets git configuration from its environment that turns off git's background maintenance and garbage collection: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT with maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0. The repository's tests run git with blank global and system config, so a commit started git's maintenance detached, which wrote into the test's repository while its temporary directory was being removed. That race failed all three of #654's build test runs on cases that otherwise passed. Git reads environment configuration even when a test blanks its config files, so no test changes.
